    # Define the cost of each activity
    cost = {
        'rest': 0,
        'contest': 1,
        'sport': 1
    }
    
    # Initialize the DP table

    # Base case: Day 1
    dp[0][activities[0]] = 0
    
    # Fill the DP table
    for i in range(1, n):
        for j in range(4):
            if j == 0:  # Rest
                dp[i][j] = min(dp[i-1][k] + cost['rest'] for k in range(4) if k != j)
            elif j == 1:  # Contest
                dp[i][j] = min(dp[i-1][k] + cost['contest'] for k in range(4) if k != j and k != 1)
            elif j == 2:  # Sport
                dp[i][j] = min(dp[i-1][k] + cost['sport'] for k in range(4) if k != j and k != 2)
            else:  # Invalid activity
                dp[i][j] = float('inf')
    
    # Return the minimum rest days for the last day
    return min(dp[n-1])

        1: 1,  # Write contest
        2: 1   # Do sport
    }
    
    # Initialize the DP table

    # Base case: Day 1
    dp[0][activities[0]] = 0
    
    # Fill the DP table
    for i in range(1, n):
        for j in range(4):
            if j == 0:  # Rest
                dp[i][j] = min(dp[i-1][k] + cost[j] for k in range(4) if k != j)
            else:
                dp[i][j] = min(dp[i-1][k] + cost[j] for k in range(4) if k != j and k != (j - 1) % 4)
    
    # The result is the minimum rest days for the last day
    return min(dp[n-1])
